verdict.rationale: Salesmate is a CRM, so in-app reporting and dashboards are a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack only describes managing contacts, deals, pipelines and activities, plus messaging, AI agents and automation. Nothing documents report builders, dashboards, or analytics on pipeline, activity or conversion.

support.subject: As a founder, I can build reports and dashboards on pipeline, activity, and conversion without exporting to a spreadsheet
